checkpointDelegatee(mapping(uint256 => u.details: If used with `balance` == `_locked[_tokenId].amount`, then this is the same as      delegating or dedelegating from `_tokenId`      If used with `balance` < `_locked[_tokenId].amount`, then this is used to adjust      `delegatedBalance` when a user's balance is modified (e.g. `increaseAmount`, `merge` etc).      If `delegatee` is 0 (i.e. user is not delegating), then do nothing.

params._increase: True if balance is increasing, false if decreasing
params._numCheckpoints: State of all user checkpoint counts

checkpointDelegator(mapping(uint256 => I.details: This function depends on `_locked` and must be called prior to token state changes.      If you wish to dedelegate only, use `_delegate(tokenId, 0)` instead.

params._delegatee: The new delegatee for the delegator. Cannot be equal to `_delegator` (use 0 instead).
params._delegator: The delegator to update checkpoints for
params._numCheckpoints: State of all user checkpoint counts
params._owner: The new (or current) owner for the delegator

getPastVotes(mapping(uint256 => uint48).details: If a checkpoint does not exist prior to the timestamp, this will return 0.      The user must also own the token at the time in order to receive a voting balance.

params._numCheckpoints: State of all user checkpoint counts

returns._0: Total voting balance including delegations at a given timestamp.

checkpointDelegatee(mapping(uint256 => u.notice: Update delegatee's `delegatedBalance` by `balance`.         Only updates if delegating to a new delegatee.

checkpointDelegator(mapping(uint256 => I.notice: Used by `_mint`, `_transferFrom`, `_burn` and `delegate`         to update delegator voting checkpoints.         Automatically dedelegates, then updates checkpoint.

getPastVotes(mapping(uint256 => uint48).notice: Retrieves historical voting balance for a token id at a given timestamp.
